# "Unwavering Resolve"
## Scripture
"Yet I will not forget you; see, I have inscribed you on the palms of my hands." – [Isaiah 49:16](https://www.bible.com/bible/59/ISA.49.16.ESV)
## Reflection
As warriors of Christ, we often face trials and battles that test our resolve and faith. It's in these moments that we must remember God's unwavering commitment to us. Just as He has inscribed us on the palms of His hands, we too must hold onto our identity in Christ, refusing to let the world's opinions or circumstances define us.

In the midst of chaos, we can draw strength from the Lord's unwavering love and dedication to us. We are His children, and He has a purpose for our lives. As we embark on this day, let us remember that our identity is not defined by our failures or successes, but by the love and forgiveness of our Savior.

May we stand firm in our faith, trusting in the Lord's guidance and provision.

## Daily Challenge
"Run 1 mile while declaring your identity in Christ."
